about: compare_baseline compares only the paths a run measured, and counts the unmeasured baselined files on one line instead of printing them as improved to zero (scope_case). The directory-target prefix branch is not mutated: record-baseline always writes mode=per-file and a directory run is whole-repo, so that pairing is refused before the scope is used, and no test reaches it. Run: mutate-on-target.py TREE jpcheck/baseline.py tests/test_check_baseline.py tests/mutants/jpt-baseline-scope-on-baseline.json
